```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
# This document reads the measurements; it never takes one. bench/parquet-pipeline.R
# writes the CSV files (the timings need quiet stretches of the machine, across
# several GPU lock windows, which one render cannot give). parquet-lib.R is
# sourced only to print each engine's code.
.libPaths(c(params$lib, .libPaths()))
out <- params$out_dir
rd <- function(f) {
  p <- file.path(out, f)
  if (file.exists(p)) utils::read.csv(p, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) else NULL
}
files <- rd("files.csv"); cr <- rd("correctness.csv"); pd <- rd("pushdown.csv")
th <- rd("threads.csv"); rdr <- rd("readers.csv"); tm <- rd("timings.csv")
fc <- rd("firstcall.csv"); forms <- rd("forms.csv")
wu <- rd("warmup.csv"); pv <- rd("provenance.csv"); sg <- rd("stages.csv")
sh <- rd("shapes.csv"); jc <- rd("joincost.csv")
sup <- rd("timings-superseded.csv")  # absent when no timing was ever replaced
lk <- rd("lockjobs.csv")             # the lock log's rows, copied by the render step
# the rowwise chunk: timings, correctness, cuplyr's native/fallback verdict, warm-ups
rw <- rd("rowwise.csv"); rwc <- rd("rowwise-correctness.csv"); rwn <- rd("rowwise-native.csv")
rww <- rd("rowwise-warmup.csv"); rwsup <- rd("rowwise-superseded.csv")
il <- rd("idle.csv")                 # the idle step: cuplyr after the GPU was left idle
ilsup <- rd("idle-superseded.csv")   # an earlier run of it, when there is one
# the three probe files are optional: the report says so when they are missing
for (nm in c("files", "cr", "pd", "th", "rdr", "tm", "fc", "wu", "pv")) {
  if (is.null(get(nm))) stop("the measurement file for `", nm, "` is missing from ", out, ": run bench/parquet-pipeline.R first")
}
source(file.path(params$root, "bench", "parquet-lib.R"), keep.source = TRUE)
engines <- pp_engines()
variants <- pp_variants()
k_const <- pp_constants()

# ---- small helpers ---------------------------------------------------------------
join_and <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  if (length(x) <= 1L) return(paste(x, collapse = ""))
  paste0(paste(x[-length(x)], collapse = ", "), " and ", x[length(x)])
}
join_or <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  if (length(x) <= 1L) return(paste(x, collapse = ""))
  paste0(paste(x[-length(x)], collapse = ", "), " or ", x[length(x)])
}
lab_n <- function(n) sub("e\\+0?", "e", format(as.numeric(n), scientific = TRUE, digits = 3), perl = TRUE)
lab_n <- Vectorize(lab_n)
fs <- function(x) {
  ifelse(is.na(x), "n/a", paste0(format(signif(x, 3), scientific = FALSE, trim = TRUE, drop0trailing = TRUE), " s"))
}
fx <- function(x, digits = 2) ifelse(is.na(x), "n/a", format(round(x, digits), nsmall = 0, trim = TRUE))
pct <- function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), "n/a", paste0(format(round(100 * x), trim = TRUE), "%"))
# one decimal, for small shares
pct1 <- function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), "n/a", paste0(format(round(100 * x, 1), nsmall = 1, trim = TRUE), "%"))
# "1 call was" / "2 calls were"
n_of <- function(n, word) paste0(n, " ", word, if (n != 1) "s")
was_were <- function(n) if (n == 1) "was" else "were"
mb <- function(b) format(round(b / 1e6), big.mark = ",", trim = TRUE)
# "x times faster/slower" for a ratio r = (this engine's time) / (the other's)
ratio_phrase <- function(r, tol = 1.1) {
  if (is.na(r)) return("not comparable with")
  if (r < 1 / tol) paste0(fx(1 / r, 1), " times faster than")
  else if (r > tol) paste0(fx(r, 1), " times slower than")
  else "about as fast as"
}
setting <- function(engine, name) {
  v <- th$value[th$engine == engine & th$setting == name]
  if (length(v)) v[[1L]] else NA_character_
}
code_block <- function(txt, lang = "r") {
  fence <- strrep("`", 3L)
  cat("\n", fence, lang, "\n", paste(txt, collapse = "\n"), "\n", fence, "\n\n", sep = "")
}
src_of <- function(fn) paste(deparse(fn, control = "useSource"), collapse = "\n")
# a function written inside another one: its lines after the first lose the enclosing indentation
src_nested <- function(fn, indent = 4L) {
  l <- deparse(fn, control = "useSource")
  if (length(l) > 1L) l[-1L] <- sub(paste0("^ {0,", indent, "}"), "", l[-1L])
  paste(l, collapse = "\n")
}

# ---- machine and versions ----------------------------------------------------------
cpu_model <- setting("machine", "cpu_model")
n_cpu <- setting("machine", "logical_cpus")
ram_gb <- round(as.numeric(setting("machine", "ram_bytes")) / 2^30)
gpu_name <- setting("machine", "gpu_name")
gpu_gb <- round(as.numeric(setting("machine", "gpu_memory_bytes")) / 2^30)
ver_cuplyr <- setting("cuplyr", "version"); git_head <- setting("cuplyr", "git_head")
ver_duckdb <- setting("duckdb", "version"); ver_arrow <- setting("dplyr", "arrow_version")
ver_dplyr <- setting("dplyr", "version"); ver_dt <- setting("data.table", "version")
ver_r <- paste(R.version$major, R.version$minor, sep = ".")
conda <- Sys.getenv("CONDA_PREFIX")
cudf_meta <- if (nzchar(conda)) list.files(file.path(conda, "conda-meta"), pattern = "^libcudf-[0-9]") else character()
ver_cudf <- if (length(cudf_meta)) sub("^libcudf-([0-9.]+)-.*$", "\\1", cudf_meta[[1L]]) else "unknown"

# ---- data and files ----------------------------------------------------------------
files <- files[order(files$table, files$rows), ]
sizes <- sort(unique(tm$rows))   # the sizes of the three main pipelines (the rowwise chunk has its own)
rw_only_files <- files[!files$rows %in% sizes, ]
tables <- unique(files$table)
rg_rows <- if ("row_group_max_rows" %in% names(files)) format(max(files$row_group_max_rows), big.mark = ",", trim = TRUE) else "n/a"
n_cols <- tapply(files$columns, files$table, max)
codec <- tolower(paste(unique(files$codec), collapse = "/"))
kept <- cr[cr$engine == "dplyr" & !is.na(cr$kept_rows) & cr$kept_rows > 0, ]
keep_frac <- function(filter) {
  d <- kept[grepl(paste0("_", filter, "$"), kept$variant) & startsWith(kept$variant, "p1"), ]
  if (!nrow(d)) return(NA_real_)
  mean(d$kept_rows / d$rows)
}
groups_of <- function(pipeline) {
  g <- cr$result_rows[startsWith(cr$variant, pipeline) & cr$engine == "dplyr" & cr$status == "ok"]
  if (length(g)) max(g) else NA
}

# ---- correctness -------------------------------------------------------------------
n_cr <- nrow(cr); n_cr_ok <- sum(cr$status == "ok")
big_result <- max(cr$result_rows, na.rm = TRUE)
# ---- timings: quiet reps, summaries, cell states -------------------------------------
tm$quiet <- as.logical(tm$quiet); tm$ok <- as.logical(tm$ok)
key_of <- function(d) paste(d$engine, d$variant, d$table, d$rows, d$cache, sep = "|")
tq <- tm[tm$rep >= 1L & tm$ok & tm$quiet, ]
cells <- unique(tm[c("engine", "variant", "table", "rows", "cache")])
cells$key <- key_of(cells)
summ <- lapply(split(tq, key_of(tq)), function(d) {
  data.frame(key = key_of(d)[1L], n = nrow(d), med = stats::median(d$secs),
             q25 = unname(stats::quantile(d$secs, 0.25)), q75 = unname(stats::quantile(d$secs, 0.75)),
             lo = min(d$secs), hi = max(d$secs), busy = stats::median(d$busy), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
})
S <- if (length(summ)) do.call(rbind, summ) else data.frame(key = character(), n = integer(), med = numeric())
S <- merge(cells, S, by = "key", all.x = TRUE)
S$n[is.na(S$n)] <- 0L
bad_status <- tapply(tm$status, key_of(tm), function(s) {
  s <- s[s != "ok"]; if (length(s)) s[[1L]] else "ok"
})
S$status <- unname(bad_status[S$key])
S$status[S$status == "ok" & S$n == 0L] <- "noisy"
S$pipeline <- substr(S$variant, 1L, 2L)
S$filter <- sub("^p[0-9]_", "", S$variant)
first0 <- tm[tm$rep == 0L & tm$ok, ]
first0 <- first0[order(first0$started), ]
rep_n <- tapply(tm$rep[tm$rep >= 1L], tm$rows[tm$rep >= 1L], function(r) max(r))
n_calls <- nrow(tm); n_busy <- sum(tm$rep >= 1L & tm$ok & !tm$quiet)
n_rep0 <- sum(tm$rep == 0L)
n_cpu_num <- as.numeric(setting("machine", "logical_cpus"))
busy_max <- as.numeric(setting("harness", "busy_max"))
busy_max_rows <- sort(unique(tm$busy_max))   # the limit recorded on each call
busy_quiet_max <- if (nrow(tq)) max(tq$busy) else NA_real_
resident_warm <- tm$resident[tm$cache == "warm" & tm$ok]
resident_cold <- tm$resident[tm$cache == "cold" & tm$ok]
# the best other engine of a cell (cuplyr excluded) and cuplyr's ratio to it
wide_cells <- function(d) {
  e <- split(d, d$engine)
  base <- e[["cuplyr"]]
  if (is.null(base)) return(NULL)
  others <- d[d$engine != "cuplyr" & d$status == "ok" & d$n > 0, ]
  if (!nrow(others)) return(NULL)
  best <- stats::aggregate(med ~ variant + table + rows + cache, data = others, FUN = min)
  names(best)[names(best) == "med"] <- "best_med"
  who <- merge(others, best, by = c("variant", "table", "rows", "cache"))
  who <- who[who$med == who$best_med, c("variant", "table", "rows", "cache", "engine")]
  names(who)[5L] <- "best_engine"
  who <- who[!duplicated(who[c("variant", "table", "rows", "cache")]), ]
  base <- base[c("variant", "table", "rows", "cache", "pipeline", "filter", "med", "n", "status")]
  m <- merge(merge(base, best, by = c("variant", "table", "rows", "cache")), who, by = c("variant", "table", "rows", "cache"))
  m$ratio <- m$med / m$best_med
  m[m$status == "ok" & m$n > 0, ]
}
W <- wide_cells(S)
if (is.null(W)) W <- data.frame(variant = character(), table = character(), rows = numeric(), cache = character(),
                                ratio = numeric(), best_engine = character(), filter = character(), pipeline = character())
n_oom <- sum(S$status == "oom")
n_cu_cells <- sum(S$engine == "cuplyr"); n_cu_early <- sum(S$engine == "cuplyr" & S$pipeline %in% c("p1", "p2"))
oom_cells <- S[S$status == "oom", ]

# ---- provenance: which code produced the measurements ----------------------------------
tstamp <- function(x) as.POSIXct(x, format = "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%OS")
# every render appends a row too (its bench/ copy is dirty until committed): the table
# and the claims below are about the steps that took the measurements
pv <- pv[pv$step != "render", ]
pv$t0 <- tstamp(pv$started); pv$t1 <- tstamp(pv$ended)
pv$minutes <- as.numeric(difftime(pv$t1, pv$t0, units = "mins"))
# a run of a step is superseded when the same step ran later for the same piece (its
# rows were replaced; the timing rows are archived): the data in use come from the rest
pv_key <- paste(pv$step, pv$sizes, pv$tables, pv$caches, pv$variants, pv$engines)
pv$superseded <- rev(duplicated(rev(pv_key)))
pvu <- pv[!pv$superseded, ]
n_pv_super <- sum(pv$superseded)
bench_heads <- unique(pvu$git_head); pkg_commits <- unique(pvu$cuplyr_commit)
heads_text <- if (length(bench_heads) == 1L) paste0("benchmark commit `", bench_heads, "`") else paste0(
  length(bench_heads), " benchmark commits, ", join_and(vapply(bench_heads, function(h) {
    st <- unique(pvu$step[pvu$git_head == h])
    paste0("`", h, "` for the ", paste(st, collapse = ", "), " step", if (length(st) > 1L) "s")
  }, "")), ",")
same_day <- format(min(pvu$t0), "%Y-%m-%d") == format(max(pvu$t1), "%Y-%m-%d")
span_text <- if (same_day) paste0("between ", format(min(pvu$t0), "%H:%M"), " and ", format(max(pvu$t1), "%H:%M"), " on ", format(min(pvu$t0), "%Y-%m-%d")) else
  paste0("between ", format(min(pvu$t0), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"), " and ", format(max(pvu$t1), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"))
all_clean <- !any(as.logical(pvu$bench_dirty)) && !any(as.logical(pvu$cuplyr_dirty))
all_ok <- all(pvu$outcome == "ok")
time_pieces <- pv[pv$step == "time", ]
n_pieces_rerun <- sum(duplicated(time_pieces[c("sizes", "tables", "caches")]))
n_super <- if (is.null(sup)) 0L else nrow(sup)
prov_label <- function(d) {
  num <- function(x) vapply(x, function(v) if (v == "all") "all" else paste(lab_n(as.numeric(strsplit(v, " ", fixed = TRUE)[[1L]])), collapse = " "), "")
  ifelse(d$step %in% c("time", "rowwise", "rowwise_check", "idle"), paste(num(d$sizes), d$tables, d$caches), "")
}

# ---- the load rule: one limit, every engine, rep and cache ---------------------------------
timed <- tm[tm$rep >= 1L & tm$ok, ]
load_tab <- do.call(rbind, lapply(split(timed, paste(timed$engine, timed$cache)), function(d) {
  data.frame(engine = d$engine[1L], cache = d$cache[1L], calls = nrow(d),
             foreign_med = stats::median(d$busy), foreign_max = max(d$busy),
             kernel_med = stats::median(d$kernel), kernel_max = max(d$kernel),
             own_med = stats::median(d$own), own_max = max(d$own), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}))
load_tab <- load_tab[order(factor(load_tab$engine, engines), factor(load_tab$cache, c("warm", "cold"))), ]
kern_cold_up <- vapply(engines, function(e) {
  k <- load_tab[load_tab$engine == e, ]
  k$kernel_med[k$cache == "cold"] > k$kernel_med[k$cache == "warm"]
}, NA)
kern_top <- timed[which.max(timed$kernel), ]
# (the table's "highest" is over every timed call, the ones over the limit included)
busy_over <- timed[!timed$quiet, ]
foreign_sentence <- paste0(
  "The median foreign share, by engine and cache state, is between ", pct1(min(load_tab$foreign_med)), " and ", pct1(max(load_tab$foreign_med)),
  ". The highest in a quiet call is ", pct1(busy_quiet_max), ", against the limit of ", pct(busy_max),
  if (busy_quiet_max < busy_max / 2) ", so every quiet call stays well below the limit (under half of it)" else ", more than half of the limit",
  if (nrow(busy_over)) paste0("; ", n_of(nrow(busy_over), "timed call"), " went over the limit (the highest at ", pct1(max(busy_over$busy)), ", the top of the table's column), ",
                              was_were(nrow(busy_over)), " run again and ", if (nrow(busy_over) == 1L) "is" else "are", " not used in any median") else "",
  ".")
wait_gave_up <- sum(tm$wait_load > tm$busy_max, na.rm = TRUE)
cell_id <- paste(tm$variant, tm$table, tm$rows, tm$cache)
interleaved <- vapply(split(tm, cell_id), function(d) {
  t <- as.numeric(tstamp(d$started))
  first_t <- tapply(t, d$engine, min); last_t <- tapply(t, d$engine, max)
  length(first_t) == length(engines) && max(first_t) < min(last_t)
}, NA)
n_cells_t <- length(interleaved); n_interleaved <- sum(interleaved)
cell_limits <- vapply(split(tm$busy_max, cell_id), function(x) length(unique(x)), 1L)
# the storage under the data directory (findmnt, lsblk): the machine's set-up, no more
disk <- tryCatch({
  m <- system2("findmnt", c("-no", "SOURCE,FSTYPE", "-T", out), stdout = TRUE, stderr = FALSE)[1L]
  src <- sub("\\[.*$", "", strsplit(m, " +")[[1L]][1L])
  list(src = src, fs = strsplit(m, " +")[[1L]][2L],
       type = trimws(system2("lsblk", c("-no", "TYPE", src), stdout = TRUE, stderr = FALSE)[1L]))
}, error = function(e) list(src = NA_character_, fs = NA_character_, type = NA_character_))
disk_text <- if (is.na(disk$src)) "The storage under the data directory could not be read." else paste0(
  "The data directory is on `", disk$src, "` (device type `", disk$type, "`, file system `", disk$fs, "`).")

# ---- the untimed process warm-up and the first timed rep -----------------------------------
wu_calls <- max(wu$call)
wu_pieces <- nrow(unique(wu[c("table", "rows", "cache")]))
wu_variants <- length(unique(wu$variant))
keys5 <- c("engine", "variant", "table", "rows", "cache")
# (S is built just below; the rep-1 ratio is filled in after it)

# ---- the lock log during the timing windows ------------------------------------------------
lock_ok <- !is.null(lk) && nrow(lk) > 0L
if (lock_ok) {
  lk_time <- function(x) as.POSIXct(sub("([+-][0-9]{2}):([0-9]{2})$", "\\1\\2", x), format = "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z")
  lk$q <- lk_time(lk$start); lk$acq <- lk$q + lk$wait_s; lk$rel <- lk$acq + lk$hold_s
  win <- pvu[pvu$step %in% c("readers", "time", "rowwise", "idle", "first", "probe"), ]
  n_windows <- nrow(win)
  own_job <- vapply(seq_len(n_windows), function(i) {
    j <- which(lk$acq <= win$t0[i] + 2 & lk$rel >= win$t1[i] - 2)
    if (length(j)) lk$worktree[j[1L]] else NA_character_
  }, "")
  n_win_in_job <- sum(!is.na(own_job))
  own_wt <- if (n_win_in_job) names(sort(table(own_job), decreasing = TRUE))[1L] else NA_character_
  # a job is logged when it ends, so a window that is still running has no hold of its own
  others <- if (is.na(own_wt)) lk else lk[lk$worktree != own_wt, ]
  ov <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(others)), function(a) {
    max(vapply(seq_len(n_windows), function(b) {
      max(0, min(as.numeric(win$t1[b]), as.numeric(others$rel[a])) - max(as.numeric(win$t0[b]), as.numeric(others$acq[a])))
    }, 0))
  }, 0)
  ov_max <- if (length(ov)) max(ov, na.rm = TRUE) else 0
  n_overlap <- sum(ov > 1.5, na.rm = TRUE)
  # a job counts when it was queued inside at least one window [t0, t1], not in a gap between two
  in_window <- vapply(others$q, function(q) any(q >= win$t0 & q <= win$t1), NA)
  queued <- others[in_window, ]
  queued_in_gaps <- sum(!in_window & others$q >= min(win$t0) & others$q <= max(win$t1))
  queued_by <- table(queued$worktree)
  n_f123 <- sum(queued$worktree == "F123") + sum(others$worktree == "F123" & ov > 0, na.rm = TRUE)
}

# ---- derived text and numbers used in the prose -------------------------------------
ncol_of <- function(tab) if (tab %in% names(n_cols)) n_cols[[tab]] else NA
med_of <- function(e, v, tab, n, cache) {
  x <- S$med[S$engine == e & S$variant == v & S$table == tab & S$rows == n & S$cache == cache & S$n > 0]
  if (length(x)) x[[1L]] else NA_real_
}
# the largest size at which every engine in `engs` has a median for every variant in `vs`
pick_size <- function(vs, tab, cache, engs = engines) {
  ok <- vapply(sizes, function(n) all(!is.na(unlist(lapply(engs, function(e) vapply(vs, function(v) med_of(e, v, tab, n, cache), 0))))), NA)
  if (any(ok)) max(sizes[ok]) else NA_real_
}
cores_word <- function(x) paste0(fx(x, 1), if (round(x, 1) == 1) " core" else " cores")
cu_own <- timed[timed$engine == "cuplyr", ]
cu_big <- cu_own[cu_own$rows == max(cu_own$rows) & cu_own$cache == "warm", ]
cu_cores <- function(d) c(med = stats::median(d$own) * n_cpu_num, max = max(d$own) * n_cpu_num)
cores_all <- cu_cores(cu_own); cores_big <- cu_cores(cu_big)
other_cores <- vapply(setdiff(engines, "cuplyr"), function(e) stats::median(timed$own[timed$engine == e]) * n_cpu_num, 0)
thread_text <- local({
  g <- function(e, nm) setting(e, nm)
  paste0("DuckDB runs ", g("duckdb", "threads"), " threads, arrow ", g("dplyr", "arrow_cpu"), " CPU and ",
         g("dplyr", "arrow_io"), " I/O threads (dplyr and data.table both read with it), data.table ",
         g("data.table", "threads"), " threads, and cuplyr runs the query on the GPU (", g("cuplyr", "gpu_devices"),
         " device)")
})
cores_text <- paste0(
  "That does not make cuplyr's process idle on the CPU: its own CPU time (user and system, all threads) is a share of all ",
  n_cpu, " logical CPUs; multiplied by ", n_cpu, " it is ", cores_word(cores_all[["med"]]), " at the median over its timed calls and ",
  cores_word(cores_big[["med"]]), " at the median for ", lab_n(max(cu_own$rows)), " rows with a warm cache (the highest single call: ",
  cores_word(cores_big[["max"]]), "). The medians for the other engines over all their timed calls are ",
  join_and(sprintf("%s %s", names(other_cores), vapply(other_cores, cores_word, ""))), ". What the CPU time is spent on in cuplyr is not examined here.")

# readers
rdr$quiet <- as.logical(rdr$quiet); rdr$ok <- as.logical(rdr$ok)
rq <- rdr[rdr$rep >= 1L & rdr$ok & rdr$quiet, ]
rsum <- if (nrow(rq)) stats::aggregate(secs ~ reader + table + rows, data = rq, FUN = stats::median) else data.frame()
reader_used <- if (grepl("nanoparquet", paste(deparse(pp_read_arrow), collapse = " "))) "nanoparquet" else "arrow"
reader_wide <- if (nrow(rsum)) stats::reshape(rsum, idvar = c("table", "rows"), timevar = "reader", direction = "wide") else data.frame()
if (nrow(reader_wide)) {
  names(reader_wide) <- sub("^secs\\.", "", names(reader_wide))
  reader_wide$faster <- ifelse(reader_wide$arrow <= reader_wide$nanoparquet, "arrow", "nanoparquet")
  reader_wide$ratio <- reader_wide$nanoparquet / reader_wide$arrow
}
n_reader_cells <- nrow(reader_wide)
n_arrow_faster <- if (n_reader_cells) sum(reader_wide$faster == "arrow") else 0L
reader_faster <- if (n_reader_cells && n_arrow_faster >= n_reader_cells / 2) "arrow" else "nanoparquet"
n_reader_faster <- if (reader_faster == "arrow") n_arrow_faster else n_reader_cells - n_arrow_faster
reader_agrees <- identical(reader_used, reader_faster) && n_reader_faster == n_reader_cells
reader_agree_text <- if (reader_agrees) "The reader the code uses is the faster one in every cell." else paste0("The code uses ", reader_used, ", which is not the faster reader in every cell; the dplyr and data.table numbers include that.")
reader_sentence <- if (!n_reader_cells) "The reader step has no quiet reps." else paste0(
  reader_faster, " is faster in ", n_reader_faster, " of ", n_reader_cells, " cells (a table and a size each)",
  if (n_reader_cells) paste0("; nanoparquet takes ", fx(min(reader_wide$ratio), 1), " to ", fx(max(reader_wide$ratio), 1),
                             " times arrow's time") else "")

# the two data.table idioms
form_sentence <- "The idiom timing (forms.csv) is not part of this data set."
form_p2_sentence <- ""
dt_form <- k_const$dt_form
if (!is.null(forms)) {
  forms$quiet <- as.logical(forms$quiet); forms$ok <- as.logical(forms$ok)
  fq <- forms[forms$rep >= 1L & forms$ok & forms$quiet, ]
  if (nrow(fq)) {
    fm <- stats::reshape(stats::aggregate(secs ~ form + variant + table + rows, data = fq, FUN = stats::median),
                         idvar = c("variant", "table", "rows"), timevar = "form", direction = "wide")
    names(fm) <- sub("^secs\\.", "", names(fm))
    fm$ratio <- fm$stepwise / fm$single
    fm$pipeline <- substr(fm$variant, 1L, 2L)
    n_single_faster <- sum(fm$single <= fm$stepwise)
    fm_p2 <- fm[fm$pipeline == "p2", ]
    form_sentence <- paste0("Two idioms were timed on one variant of each pipeline, in every table and size (forms.csv): a single call (the filter in `i`, the arithmetic inside `j`) and a stepwise form (filter, then `:=`, then aggregate). The single call was faster in ",
                            n_single_faster, " of ", nrow(fm), " cells; the benchmark uses the ", dt_form, " form",
                            if (dt_form == "single" && n_single_faster < nrow(fm) / 2) ", although the other was faster in most cells" else
                              if (dt_form != "single" && n_single_faster >= nrow(fm) / 2) ", although the single-call form was faster in most cells" else "", ".")
    if (nrow(fm_p2)) {
      form_p2_sentence <- paste0("The join pipeline joins the filtered facts to the dimension first (a keyed `data.table` join), so its result is a new table either way: in its ",
                                 nrow(fm_p2), " cells the stepwise time is ", fx(min(fm_p2$ratio), 2), " to ", fx(max(fm_p2$ratio), 2),
                                 " times the single-call time (the stepwise form was faster in ", sum(fm_p2$stepwise < fm_p2$single), "), so the choice hardly matters there.")
    }
  }
}

# ---- result tables and plots ---------------------------------------------------------
fnum <- function(x) format(signif(x, 3), scientific = FALSE, trim = TRUE, drop0trailing = TRUE)
cell_text <- function(d) {
  ifelse(d$status == "oom", "does not fit",
         ifelse(d$status %in% c("error", "mismatch"), d$status,
                ifelse(d$n == 0L | is.na(d$med), "no quiet rep",
                       sprintf("%s (%s-%s) n=%d", fnum(d$med), fnum(d$q25), fnum(d$q75), d$n))))
}
res_tab <- function(p, cache) {
  d <- S[S$pipeline == p & S$cache == cache, ]
  if (!nrow(d)) return(NULL)
  d$text <- cell_text(d)
  keys <- unique(d[c("filter", "table", "rows")])
  keys <- keys[order(factor(keys$filter, c("push", "nopush")), keys$table, keys$rows), ]
  rows <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(keys)), function(i) {
    r <- d[d$filter == keys$filter[i] & d$table == keys$table[i] & d$rows == keys$rows[i], ]
    usable <- r$n > 0L & r$status == "ok"
    best <- if (any(usable)) r$engine[usable][which.min(r$med[usable])] else NA_character_
    cells <- vapply(engines, function(e) {
      x <- r[r$engine == e, ]
      if (!nrow(x)) "-" else if (identical(e, best)) paste0("**", x$text[[1L]], "**") else x$text[[1L]]
    }, "")
    out <- data.frame(filter = keys$filter[i], table = keys$table[i], rows = lab_n(keys$rows[i]), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    for (e in engines) out[[e]] <- cells[[e]]
    out
  })
  do.call(rbind, rows)
}
show_tab <- function(p, cache) {
  t <- res_tab(p, cache)
  if (is.null(t)) { cat("\nNo ", cache, " cells for this pipeline.\n\n", sep = ""); return(invisible()) }
  cat("\n", paste(knitr::kable(t, format = "pipe", row.names = FALSE), collapse = "\n"), "\n\n", sep = "")
}
eng_cols <- c(cuplyr = "#009E73", duckdb = "#E69F00", dplyr = "#0072B2", data.table = "#CC79A7")
plot_pipeline <- function(p) {
  d <- S[S$pipeline == p & S$n > 0L & S$status == "ok", ]
  if (!nrow(d)) return(invisible(NULL))
  d$engine <- factor(d$engine, engines)
  d$filter <- factor(d$filter, c("push", "nopush"))
  g <- ggplot2::ggplot(d, ggplot2::aes(x = rows, y = med, colour = engine, group = engine)) +
    ggplot2::geom_linerange(ggplot2::aes(ymin = q25, ymax = q75), alpha = 0.6) +
    ggplot2::geom_line() + ggplot2::geom_point(size = 1.6) +
    ggplot2::scale_x_log10(breaks = sizes, labels = lab_n(sizes)) +
    ggplot2::scale_y_log10() +
    ggplot2::scale_colour_manual(values = eng_cols, drop = FALSE) +
    ggplot2::facet_grid(table + cache ~ filter, labeller = ggplot2::label_both) +
    ggplot2::labs(x = "rows in the fact table", y = "seconds per call (median, bars = interquartile range)", colour = NULL) +
    ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
    ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "bottom", panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_blank())
  oo <- S[S$pipeline == p & S$status == "oom", ]
  if (nrow(oo)) {
    oo$filter <- factor(oo$filter, c("push", "nopush"))
    oo$engine <- factor(oo$engine, engines)
    oo$y <- max(d$med)
    g <- g + ggplot2::geom_point(data = oo, ggplot2::aes(x = rows, y = y, colour = engine), shape = 4, size = 3, stroke = 1.2) +
      ggplot2::labs(caption = "a cross marks a cell that does not fit in memory")
  }
  g
}

# ---- where cuplyr wins and loses -------------------------------------------------------
W$win <- W$ratio < 1
n_cmp <- nrow(W); n_win <- sum(W$win)
cnt <- function(cache) c(win = sum(W$win & W$cache == cache), all = sum(W$cache == cache))
cw <- cnt("warm"); cc <- cnt("cold")
gs <- if (n_cmp) do.call(rbind, lapply(split(W, paste(W$rows, W$cache, W$filter)), function(d) {
  data.frame(rows = d$rows[1L], cache = d$cache[1L], filter = d$filter[1L], cells = nrow(d), wins = sum(d$win),
             median_ratio = stats::median(d$ratio), worst = max(d$ratio), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
})) else data.frame()
if (nrow(gs)) gs <- gs[order(gs$rows, gs$cache, factor(gs$filter, c("push", "nopush"))), ]
lose_groups <- if (nrow(gs)) gs[gs$wins < gs$cells / 2, ] else gs
lose_text <- if (!n_cmp) "There are no cells in which cuplyr and another engine both have quiet reps." else if (!nrow(lose_groups)) {
  "There is no combination of size, cache state and filter in which cuplyr has the lowest median in fewer than half of its cells."
} else paste0("cuplyr has the lowest median in fewer than half of its cells for ",
              join_and(sprintf("%s rows with a %s cache and the %s filter (%d of %d cells)", lab_n(lose_groups$rows),
                               lose_groups$cache, lose_groups$filter, lose_groups$wins, lose_groups$cells)), ".")
lose_by <- if (any(!W$win)) table(W$best_engine[!W$win]) else NULL
lose_by_text <- if (is.null(lose_by)) "cuplyr never loses a cell." else paste0(
  "In the cells it loses, the fastest engine is ", join_and(sprintf("%s (%d)", names(lose_by), as.integer(lose_by))), ".")
lost <- W[!W$win, ]
lost_pipes <- table(factor(lost$pipeline, sort(unique(W$pipeline))))
all_pipes <- table(factor(W$pipeline, sort(unique(W$pipeline))))
join_size <- pick_size(c("p1_push", "p2_push"), "narrow", "warm")
join_x <- function(e) med_of(e, "p2_push", "narrow", join_size, "warm") / med_of(e, "p1_push", "narrow", join_size, "warm")
lose_pipe_text <- if (!nrow(lost)) "" else paste0(
  " By pipeline, the cells in which cuplyr is not the fastest are ",
  join_and(sprintf("%s (%d of its %d cells)", names(lost_pipes)[lost_pipes > 0], as.integer(lost_pipes[lost_pipes > 0]), as.integer(all_pipes[lost_pipes > 0]))), ".",
  if (is.na(join_size)) "" else paste0(" With the pushed filter at ", lab_n(join_size), " rows (narrow table, warm cache), the join pipeline p2 takes ",
    fx(join_x("cuplyr"), 1), " times the time of p1 in cuplyr and ", fx(join_x("duckdb"), 1), " times in DuckDB."))
range_text <- if (n_cmp) paste0("cuplyr's median is ", fx(min(W$ratio)), " to ", fx(max(W$ratio)),
                                " times the fastest other engine's, over the cells where cuplyr and at least one other engine have quiet reps") else ""
n_dt_best <- if (n_cmp) sum(W$best_engine == "data.table") else 0L
# cells decided within a tolerance (a near-tie), next to the win and loss counts
tie_tol <- 1.1
W$near <- W$ratio < tie_tol & W$ratio > 1 / tie_tol
n_near <- sum(W$near); n_clear_win <- sum(W$ratio <= 1 / tie_tol); n_clear_loss <- sum(W$ratio >= tie_tol)
n_near_win <- sum(W$near & W$win); n_near_loss <- sum(W$near & !W$win)
near_text <- if (!n_cmp) "" else paste0(
  "Counted with a margin of a factor of ", fx(tie_tol, 1), ", the best other engine's median is at least ", fx(tie_tol, 1), " times cuplyr's in ", n_of(n_clear_win, "cell"),
  ", cuplyr's is at least ", fx(tie_tol, 1), " times the best other engine's in ", n_clear_loss, ", and the two are within that factor of each other in ", n_near,
  " (", n_near_win, " of them counted above as ", if (n_near_win == 1L) "a win" else "wins", " and ", n_near_loss, " as ", if (n_near_loss == 1L) "a loss" else "losses", ").")
# what each CPU engine is good at: the lowest median among DuckDB, dplyr and data.table
cpu_engs <- setdiff(engines, "cuplyr")
cpu_cells <- S[S$engine %in% cpu_engs & S$status == "ok" & S$n > 0L, ]
cpu_best <- do.call(rbind, lapply(split(cpu_cells, paste(cpu_cells$variant, cpu_cells$table, cpu_cells$rows, cpu_cells$cache)), function(d) {
  if (nrow(d) < length(cpu_engs)) return(NULL)
  data.frame(pipeline = d$pipeline[1L], rows = d$rows[1L], best = d$engine[which.min(d$med)], stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}))
cpu_sentence <- if (is.null(cpu_best) || !nrow(cpu_best)) "" else {
  tab_all <- table(factor(cpu_best$best, cpu_engs))
  by_pipe <- vapply(sort(unique(cpu_best$pipeline)), function(p) {
    t <- table(factor(cpu_best$best[cpu_best$pipeline == p], cpu_engs))
    paste0(p, ": ", join_and(sprintf("%s %d", names(t)[t > 0], as.integer(t[t > 0]))), " of ", sum(t))
  }, "")
  paste0("Among the three CPU engines alone (cuplyr left out), the lowest median is ", join_and(sprintf("%s's in %d", names(tab_all)[tab_all > 0], as.integer(tab_all[tab_all > 0]))),
         " of the ", nrow(cpu_best), " cells where all three have quiet reps. By pipeline: ", join_and(by_pipe), ".")
}

# pushdown evidence
pdf <- pd[startsWith(pd$source, "fact"), ]
pdf$n_read <- lengths(strsplit(pdf$columns_read, ","))
pdf$total_cols <- unname(n_cols[pdf$table])
push_size <- pick_size(c("p1_push", "p1_nopush"), "narrow", "warm")
ratio_pn <- function(e, tab = "narrow", cache = "warm", n = push_size) {
  med_of(e, "p1_push", tab, n, cache) / med_of(e, "p1_nopush", tab, n, cache)
}
pd_row <- function(v, tab = "narrow", n = push_size) pdf[pdf$variant == v & pdf$table == tab & pdf$rows == n, ][1L, ]
# the pushed filter's time relative to the other filter's (first pipeline, narrow, warm), by size
pn_size <- do.call(rbind, lapply(sizes, function(n) {
  r <- pd_row("p1_push", "narrow", n)
  data.frame(rows = n, kept = r$row_groups_after_stats, total = r$row_groups_total,
             decoded = r$rows_decoded / n, returned = r$rows_read / n,
             t(vapply(engines, function(e) ratio_pn(e, n = n), 0)), check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}))
pn_big <- unlist(pn_size[pn_size$rows == max(sizes), engines])
pn_cpu <- unlist(pn_size[c("dplyr", "data.table")])
pn_cpu_big <- unlist(pn_size[pn_size$rows == max(sizes), c("dplyr", "data.table")])
pn_pruned <- pn_size[!is.na(pn_size$kept) & pn_size$kept < pn_size$total, ]
pn_whole <- pn_size[!is.na(pn_size$kept) & pn_size$kept == pn_size$total, ]
pn_cu_lower_at <- if (nrow(pn_pruned)) pn_pruned$rows[pn_pruned$cuplyr < vapply(seq_len(nrow(pn_pruned)), function(i) min(unlist(pn_pruned[i, c("dplyr", "data.table")])), 0)] else numeric()
pn_cu_not_lower_at <- setdiff(pn_pruned$rows, pn_cu_lower_at)
keep_push <- keep_frac("push"); keep_nopush <- keep_frac("nopush")
push_sentence <- paste0(
  "Both filters keep about the same share of the rows (", pct(keep_push), " and ", pct(keep_nopush), "), but the pushed filter is not the same work as the other one: ",
  "dplyr and data.table push nothing and read every row, and their time for the pushed variant is ", fx(min(pn_cpu), 2), " to ", fx(max(pn_cpu), 2),
  " times that of the other, over the sizes in the table below. So the filters differ in cost on their own, and the gap in cuplyr's time cannot be put down to the pushdown alone. ",
  if (nrow(pn_whole)) paste0("Where the pushed filter skips no row group (", join_and(lab_n(pn_whole$rows)), " rows: the file has a single row group), cuplyr's ratio is ",
                            join_and(fx(pn_whole$cuplyr, 2)), ". ") else "",
  if (nrow(pn_pruned)) paste0("Where it skips row groups (", join_and(sprintf("%d of %d kept at %s rows", as.integer(pn_pruned$kept), as.integer(pn_pruned$total), lab_n(pn_pruned$rows))),
                             "), cuplyr's ratio is ", join_and(fx(pn_pruned$cuplyr, 2)), ". It is lower than both CPU engines' ratios at ",
                             if (length(pn_cu_lower_at)) join_and(lab_n(pn_cu_lower_at)) else "none of those sizes",
                             if (length(pn_cu_not_lower_at)) paste0(" rows and not at ", join_and(lab_n(pn_cu_not_lower_at)), " rows") else " rows",
                             if (length(pn_cu_lower_at)) ". Where it is lower, skipping row groups may be adding to the filters' own cost difference; this table does not separate the two."
                             else ", so this data does not show a gain from skipping row groups beyond the filters' own cost difference.") else "",
  if (length(pn_cu_lower_at) && !is.na(pn_big[["duckdb"]]) && pn_big[["duckdb"]] < min(pn_cpu_big)) paste0(" DuckDB's ratio at ", lab_n(max(sizes)), " rows is lower than the CPU engines' too (", fx(pn_big[["duckdb"]], 2),
                                                                             "), which fits it using row group statistics as well (not checked here).") else "")

# projection: the wide table against the narrow one, same variant and size
proj_size <- pick_size("p1_nopush", "wide", "warm")
proj_size <- if (is.na(proj_size)) NA_real_ else proj_size
proj_ratio <- vapply(engines, function(e) med_of(e, "p1_nopush", "wide", proj_size, "warm") / med_of(e, "p1_nopush", "narrow", proj_size, "warm"), 0)
proj_row <- pdf[pdf$variant == "p1_nopush" & pdf$table == "wide" & pdf$rows == proj_size, ][1L, ]
proj_words <- function(r) if (is.na(r)) "has no comparable cells" else if (r > 1.25) paste0("is ", fx(r), " times slower on the wide table") else "does not slow down on the wide table"
proj_sentence <- if (is.na(proj_size)) "Wide and narrow cells with quiet reps do not overlap." else paste0(
  "At ", lab_n(proj_size), " rows with the nopush filter and a warm cache, the wide table has ", ncol_of("wide"), " columns against ",
  ncol_of("narrow"), "; every engine is asked for the same ", proj_row$n_read, " columns. ",
  join_and(sprintf("%s %s", engines, vapply(proj_ratio[engines], proj_words, ""))), ".")

# cold against warm
cold_size <- pick_size("p1_nopush", "narrow", "cold")
cw_ratio <- vapply(engines, function(e) med_of(e, "p1_nopush", "narrow", cold_size, "cold") / med_of(e, "p1_nopush", "narrow", cold_size, "warm"), 0)
cold_sentence <- if (is.na(cold_size)) "No size has quiet cold and warm reps for every engine." else paste0(
  "At ", lab_n(cold_size), " rows (narrow table, nopush filter, first pipeline) the cold call takes ",
  join_and(sprintf("%s times the warm call for %s", fx(cw_ratio[engines], 2), engines)), ".")

# the first call of a cell (rep 0) against the median of its quiet reps
rep0 <- merge(first0[c("engine", "variant", "table", "rows", "cache", "secs")], S[c("engine", "variant", "table", "rows", "cache", "med")],
              by = c("engine", "variant", "table", "rows", "cache"))
rep0$ratio <- rep0$secs / rep0$med
rep0_med <- tapply(rep0$ratio, rep0$engine, stats::median)
rep0_sentence <- if (!nrow(rep0)) "" else paste0(
  "Within a cell, the first call (rep 0, after the warm-up, not in the medians) takes this multiple of the cell's median (median over cells): ",
  join_and(sprintf("%s %s", engines, fx(rep0_med[engines], 2))), ".")

# the first timed rep (rep 1) against its cell's median, after the untimed warm-up
rep1 <- merge(tm[tm$rep == 1L & tm$ok, c(keys5, "secs")], S[c(keys5, "med")], by = keys5)
rep1$ratio <- rep1$secs / rep1$med
rep1_med <- tapply(rep1$ratio, rep1$engine, stats::median)
rep1_top <- rep1[which.max(rep1$ratio), ]

# ---- what cuplyr's time is spent on: the stages probe -------------------------------------------
have_stages <- !is.null(sg)
small_share <- 0.05   # what counts as a small part of a call
stages_intro <- "The stages probe (`stages.csv`) is not part of this data set."
stage_sentence <- ""
if (have_stages) {
  sg$quiet <- as.logical(sg$quiet); sg$ok <- as.logical(sg$ok)
  n_sg_calls <- sum(sg$rep >= 1L); n_sg_busy <- sum(sg$rep >= 1L & !sg$quiet)
  sgm <- stats::aggregate(secs ~ stage + variant + rows, data = sg[sg$rep >= 1L & sg$ok & sg$quiet, ], FUN = stats::median)
  sgw <- stats::reshape(sgm, idvar = c("variant", "rows"), timevar = "stage", direction = "wide")
  names(sgw) <- sub("^secs\\.", "", names(sgw))
  sgw$read_share <- sgw$read / sgw$full
  sgw$rest_share <- (sgw$compute - sgw$read) / sgw$full
  sgw$collect_share <- sgw$collect_only / sgw$full
  sgw <- sgw[order(sgw$rows, sgw$variant), ]
  sg_big <- sgw[sgw$rows == max(sgw$rows), ]
  sg_ranges <- function(x, f = pct) paste0(f(min(x)), " to ", f(max(x)))
  stages_intro <- paste0(
    "The results are small (at most ", big_result, " rows). To see how cuplyr's time divides, the `probe` step ran four separate calls for the two variants of the first pipeline at ", join_and(lab_n(sort(unique(sgw$rows)))),
    " rows (narrow table, warm cache, the same quiet-machine rule as above): the scan alone (the lazy `read_parquet_gpu` read, the pushed filter if the variant has one, and the needed columns, computed into a GPU table), the whole plan computed into a GPU table, a `collect()` of a table that was computed beforehand (the transfer to R), and the benchmark's whole call. Each stage ends with `gpu_sync()`, so queued GPU work is counted in the stage that queued it. The stages are separate calls, so their times do not add up exactly; the shares are relative to the whole call. Each stage ran ", wu_calls, " times untimed before its timed reps (after one untimed run of the plan to build the computed table), so the stages leave out the start-up cost of a first call (see the first-call section). ",
    n_sg_busy, " of the ", n_sg_calls, " probe calls ", was_were(n_sg_busy), " not quiet and ", if (n_sg_busy == 1L) "is" else "are", " left out.")
  stage_sentence <- paste0(
    "At ", lab_n(max(sgw$rows)), " rows (warm cache, narrow table), the scan alone takes ", sg_ranges(sg_big$read_share), " of the whole call in the two first-pipeline variants, the rest of the plan (filter, mutate, aggregate) ",
    sg_ranges(sg_big$rest_share), ", and collecting a result that is already computed takes ", sg_ranges(sg_big$collect_share, pct1), ". ",
    paste0(
      if (all(sg_big$collect_share < small_share)) paste0("So, in these calls, bringing the answer to R is under ", pct(small_share), " of cuplyr's time in both variants")
      else paste0("So, in these calls, bringing the answer to R is not negligible (", sg_ranges(sg_big$collect_share, pct1), " of the call)"),
      if (all(sg_big$read_share > sg_big$rest_share & sg_big$read_share > sg_big$collect_share)) ", and the scan (reading and decoding the file) is the largest of the three parts in both."
      else if (any(sg_big$read_share > sg_big$rest_share & sg_big$read_share > sg_big$collect_share)) ", and the scan is the largest of the three parts in only some of the variants."
      else ", and the scan is not the largest of the three parts in either variant."))
}

# ---- why cuplyr loses the join pipeline: the join probe ------------------------------------------
have_join <- !is.null(jc)
join_sentence <- "The join probe (`joincost.csv`) is not part of this data set."
join_busy_note <- ""
if (have_join) {
  jc$quiet <- as.logical(jc$quiet); jc$ok <- as.logical(jc$ok)
  n_jc_busy <- sum(jc$rep >= 1L & !jc$quiet)
  join_busy_note <- paste0(n_jc_busy, " of the probe's calls ", was_were(n_jc_busy), " not quiet and ", if (n_jc_busy == 1L) "is" else "are", " left out.")
  jm <- stats::aggregate(secs ~ engine + op + variant + rows, data = jc[jc$rep >= 1L & jc$ok & jc$quiet, ], FUN = stats::median)
  jget <- function(e, op, v, n) { x <- jm$secs[jm$engine == e & jm$op == op & jm$variant == v & jm$rows == n]; if (length(x)) x[[1L]] else NA_real_ }
  j_n <- max(jm$rows)
  jt <- do.call(rbind, lapply(sort(unique(jm$rows)), function(n) do.call(rbind, lapply(c("p2_push", "p2_nopush"), function(v) {
    data.frame(rows = n, variant = v,
               cj = jget("cuplyr", "join", v, n), cs = jget("cuplyr", "summarise", v, n), cjs = jget("cuplyr", "join+summarise", v, n),
               dj = jget("duckdb", "join", v, n), ds = jget("duckdb", "summarise", v, n), djs = jget("duckdb", "join+summarise", v, n),
               stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }))))
  jt_big <- jt[jt$rows == j_n, ]
  j_over <- jt_big$cj / jt_big$cs                    # cuplyr: the join against the aggregate of the same rows
  j_share <- jt_big$cj / jt_big$cjs                  # cuplyr: the join's share of join + aggregate
  p2_extra <- vapply(c("p2_push", "p2_nopush"), function(v) {
    med_of("cuplyr", v, "narrow", j_n, "warm") - med_of("cuplyr", sub("p2", "p1", v), "narrow", j_n, "warm")
  }, 0)
  p2_push_fact <- pdf[pdf$variant == "p2_push" & pdf$table == "narrow" & pdf$rows == j_n & pdf$plan == "fact scan under the join", ]
  p1_push_fact <- pdf[pdf$variant == "p1_push" & pdf$table == "narrow" & pdf$rows == j_n & pdf$plan == "pipeline", ]
  same_scan <- nrow(p2_push_fact) == 1L && nrow(p1_push_fact) == 1L && !is.na(p2_push_fact$row_groups_after_stats) &&
    identical(p2_push_fact$row_groups_after_stats, p1_push_fact$row_groups_after_stats) && identical(p2_push_fact$row_groups_total, p1_push_fact$row_groups_total)
  p2_close <- all(abs(p2_extra - jt_big$cj) / jt_big$cj < 0.2)
  join_sentence <- paste0(
    "On inputs already on the device at ", lab_n(j_n), " rows, cuplyr's join of the filtered facts to the dimension takes ", fs(jt_big$cj[1L]), " (pushed filter) and ", fs(jt_big$cj[2L]),
    " (other filter), which is ", fx(j_over[1L], 1), " and ", fx(j_over[2L], 1), " times its aggregate of the same rows (", fs(jt_big$cs[1L]), " and ", fs(jt_big$cs[2L]),
    "), and ", pct(j_share[1L]), " and ", pct(j_share[2L]), " of its join and aggregate together. With the pushed filter, cuplyr's join alone is ", ratio_phrase(jt_big$cj[1L] / jt_big$dj[1L]),
    " DuckDB's join into a table, while DuckDB's join and aggregate in one query (", fs(jt_big$djs[1L]), ") is ", ratio_phrase(jt_big$djs[1L] / jt_big$cjs[1L]), " cuplyr's (", fs(jt_big$cjs[1L]),
    "). In the benchmark itself the join pipeline takes ", fs(p2_extra[[1L]]), " (pushed filter) and ", fs(p2_extra[[2L]]), " (other filter) longer than the first pipeline in cuplyr at ",
    lab_n(j_n), " rows (narrow table, warm cache), ", if (p2_close) "close to the join's time here. " else "which differs from the join's time here. ",
    if (nrow(p2_push_fact) == 1L && !is.na(p2_push_fact$row_groups_after_stats)) paste0("The check step ran the join pipeline with the pushed filter once more with the dimension computed first, so that the fact file is the plan's only parquet read (the `fact scan under the join` row of `pushdown.csv`): the scan keeps ", p2_push_fact$row_groups_after_stats, " of ", p2_push_fact$row_groups_total,
      " row groups and decodes ", pct(p2_push_fact$rows_decoded / p2_push_fact$rows), " of the rows, and the first pipeline's scan keeps ", p1_push_fact$row_groups_after_stats, " of ", p1_push_fact$row_groups_total, ", ",
      if (same_scan) "so the pushdown works the same under the join. " else "so the pushdown under the join differs from the first pipeline's. ") else "",
    "The probe shows where the time goes (the join, not the scan or the aggregate); it does not show why the join takes that long.")
}

# ---- slow calls per new pipeline shape: the shapes probe ------------------------------------------
have_shapes <- !is.null(sh)
shapes_sentence <- "The shapes probe (`shapes.csv`) is not part of this data set."
shapes_short <- shapes_sentence
shapes_intro <- ""
shapes_calls <- "n/a"
shapes_rows <- NA
smallest <- "scan"
sh_alone <- data.frame(shape = character(), secs = numeric())
if (have_shapes) {
  shape_names <- unique(sh$shape)
  best_of <- tapply(sh$secs, sh$shape, min)
  sh$best <- unname(best_of[sh$shape])
  sh$slow <- sh$secs > 3 * sh$best
  sh_alone <- sh[sh$mode == "alone", ]; sh_seq <- sh[sh$mode == "sequence", ]
  n_shapes <- length(shape_names)
  alone_slow <- tapply(sh_alone$slow, sh_alone$shape, sum)
  alone_first2 <- tapply(sh_alone$slow[sh_alone$call <= 2L], sh_alone$shape[sh_alone$call <= 2L], sum)
  n_alone_both <- sum(alone_first2 == 2L)
  seq_first2 <- tapply(sh_seq$slow[sh_seq$call <= 2L], sh_seq$shape[sh_seq$call <= 2L], sum)
  seq_later <- setdiff(shape_names, shape_names[[1L]])
  n_seq_later <- sum(seq_first2[seq_later] >= 1L)
  smallest <- shape_names[[1L]]
  sh_ratio <- function(d, j) d$secs[d$call == j] / d$best[d$call == j]
  alone_ratio1 <- vapply(shape_names, function(z) sh_ratio(sh_alone[sh_alone$shape == z, ], 1L), 0)
  seq_ratio_max <- vapply(seq_later, function(z) max(sh_seq$secs[sh_seq$shape == z & sh_seq$call <= 2L] / sh_seq$best[sh_seq$shape == z][1L]), 0)
  shapes_rows <- sh$rows_in_file[[1L]]
  shapes_calls <- join_and(fs(sh_alone$secs[sh_alone$shape == smallest]))
  shapes_intro <- paste0("The first-call finding is not confined to a process's first calls, and the shapes probe shows it. The shapes are `scan` (read one column and collect it), `filter_int` (an integer filter on the whole file), `filter_date_int` (the pushed Date and integer filter), `summarise` (a grouped count), `mutate_sum` (a new column and its sum) and `p1_push` (the first pipeline).")
  shapes_sentence <- paste0(
    "The probe repeats small cuplyr pipelines in fresh processes (", n_shapes, " shapes, each alone for ", max(sh_alone$call), " calls, then all in one process in order for ", max(sh_seq$call),
    " calls each; the file has ", lab_n(shapes_rows), " rows). A call is slow when it takes more than three times the shape's fastest call in the probe. Alone, the first two calls are slow in ",
    n_alone_both, " of the ", n_shapes, " shapes, and the first call takes ", fx(min(alone_ratio1), 0), " to ", fx(max(alone_ratio1), 0), " times the fastest. This includes the smallest shape (`",
    smallest, "`: read one column and collect it), which has ", alone_slow[[smallest]], " slow calls. In the sequence, ", n_seq_later, " of the ", length(seq_later),
    " shapes after the first have a slow call among their first two, up to ", fx(max(seq_ratio_max), 0), " times their fastest call",
    if (n_seq_later >= 1L) ". So a new pipeline shape in an already warm process can be slow for its first calls, and the cost is not paid once per process." else ".")
  shapes_short <- paste0(
    "The shapes probe (in the first-call section) finds the pattern beyond the full pipeline: alone, ", n_alone_both, " of ", n_shapes, " shapes have two slow first calls, and in one process, ",
    n_seq_later, " of the ", length(seq_later), " shapes after the first have a slow call among their first two.")
}

# ---- the timing process against a fresh process (data.table's caveat) ---------------------------------
fcm <- stats::aggregate(secs ~ engine + variant, data = fc[fc$call >= 2L, ], FUN = stats::median)
tn <- S[S$table == "narrow" & S$rows == unique(fc$rows)[1L] & S$cache == "warm" & S$n > 0L, c("engine", "variant", "med")]
shared <- merge(tn, fcm, by = c("engine", "variant"))
shared$ratio <- shared$med / shared$secs
shared_med <- tapply(shared$ratio, shared$engine, stats::median)

# ---- the first call in a fresh process ----------------------------------------------------
fc <- fc[order(fc$engine, fc$variant, fc$call), ]
fc_k <- max(fc$call)
fc_one <- function(d) {
  d <- d[order(d$call), ]
  steady <- stats::median(d$secs[d$call > fc_k / 2])
  slow <- d$secs > 3 * steady
  lead <- 0L
  while (lead < nrow(d) && isTRUE(slow[lead + 1L])) lead <- lead + 1L
  data.frame(engine = d$engine[1L], variant = d$variant[1L], lead = lead,
             lead_secs = if (lead) mean(d$secs[seq_len(lead)]) else NA_real_, steady = steady,
             first = d$secs[1L], load = d$load_secs[1L], stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}
FC <- do.call(rbind, lapply(split(fc, paste(fc$engine, fc$variant)), fc_one))
fc_cu <- FC[FC$engine == "cuplyr", ]
cu_lead_med <- if (nrow(fc_cu)) stats::median(fc_cu$lead) else NA
cu_p1 <- FC[FC$engine == "cuplyr" & FC$variant == "p1_push", ]
n_var <- nrow(fc_cu); n_var_lead <- sum(fc_cu$lead >= 1L)
fc_rows <- unique(fc$rows)
fc_secs <- function(e, v, j) { x <- fc$secs[fc$engine == e & fc$variant == v & fc$call == j]; if (length(x)) x[[1L]] else NA_real_ }
first_finding <- if (!nrow(cu_p1)) {
  "The first-call step has no cuplyr rows for the first pipeline."
} else if (cu_p1$lead[[1L]] >= 1L) {
  paste0(
  "In a fresh process the first ", cu_p1$lead[[1L]], " call", if (cu_p1$lead[[1L]] > 1L) "s", " of cuplyr's pipeline `p1_push` at ", lab_n(fc_rows[[1L]]),
  " rows take about ", fs(cu_p1$lead_secs[[1L]]), " each (the first takes ", fs(fc_secs("cuplyr", "p1_push", 1L)), ", the second ", fs(fc_secs("cuplyr", "p1_push", 2L)), ", the third ",
  fs(fc_secs("cuplyr", "p1_push", 3L)), "), and the later calls about ", fs(cu_p1$steady[[1L]]), ". The slowness appears in ", n_var_lead, " of the ", n_var,
  " cuplyr variants, with a median of ", fx(cu_lead_med, 0), " slow calls per variant.")
} else "The first calls of cuplyr's pipeline `p1_push` are no slower than its later calls in a fresh process."

rep_text <- if (length(rep_n)) join_and(sprintf("%s rows: %d", lab_n(as.numeric(names(rep_n))), as.integer(rep_n))) else "none"
oom_text <- if (!n_oom) "No cell ran out of memory." else local({
  g <- unique(oom_cells[c("engine", "rows", "table")])
  paste0("Cells that do not fit: ", join_and(vapply(seq_len(nrow(g)), function(i) {
    o <- oom_cells[oom_cells$engine == g$engine[i] & oom_cells$rows == g$rows[i] & oom_cells$table == g$table[i], ]
    sprintf("%s at %s rows on the %s table (%d variants, %s)", g$engine[i], lab_n(g$rows[i]), g$table[i],
            length(unique(o$variant)), join_and(unique(o$cache)))
  }, "")), ".")
})
lock_sentence <- if (!lock_ok) "The lock log (`lockjobs.csv`) is not part of this data set, so what else used the GPU while the timings ran is not known." else paste0(
  "The lock log lists the GPU jobs of every worktree. ", n_win_in_job, " of the ", n_windows, " timing windows (the readers, time, rowwise, idle, first and probe steps of `provenance.csv` whose data are in use) lie inside one lock hold of ",
  if (is.na(own_wt)) "a logged job (a job is logged when it ends)" else own_wt,
  ". Jobs of other worktrees held the lock for at most ", fx(ov_max, 1), " seconds inside a window (the log's resolution is one second), and ", n_overlap, " of them overlapped by more than that. ",
  if (nrow(queued)) paste0(nrow(queued), " jobs of other worktrees (", join_and(sprintf("%s: %d", names(queued_by), as.integer(queued_by))), ") were queued inside a window, each tested against every window's start and end",
                           if (queued_in_gaps) paste0("; ", queued_in_gaps, " more were queued in the gaps between windows and are not counted") else "", ". ")
  else paste0("No job of another worktree was queued inside a window",
              if (queued_in_gaps) paste0(" (", queued_in_gaps, " were queued in the gaps between windows)") else "", ". "),
  "F123 has ", n_f123, " jobs in the log during the windows. Work outside the lock (compiles, `tools/build`) is not in the log. A compile's user-space CPU time would show as foreign load, which the quiet-machine rule bounds; its system time would show only as kernel time, which is outside the rule.")
shared_sentence <- paste0(
  "Each engine's median time in the shared timing process at ", lab_n(unique(fc$rows)[1L]), " rows (narrow table, warm cache, over the variants), relative to its median over calls 2 to ", max(fc$call),
  " in a fresh process of its own: ", join_and(sprintf("%s %s", engines, fx(shared_med[engines], 2))), ". ",
  if (max(shared_med) > 1.2) paste0(names(which.max(shared_med)), "'s numbers in the tables above are therefore likely higher than they would be in a process of its own; the data do not show why. ") else "",
  if (n_dt_best == 0L) "data.table is the fastest other engine in no cell, so no win or loss of cuplyr depends on its numbers."
  else paste0("data.table is the fastest other engine in ", n_dt_best, " of the ", n_cmp, " cells, and those comparisons depend on its numbers."))

# ---- the GPU's idle cost: the idle probe, and the gaps before cuplyr's timed calls ---------------------
have_idle <- !is.null(il) && nrow(il) > 0L
idle_factor <- 1.25   # a median this many times the no-idle median counts as slowed by the idle time
idle_gpu <- c("cuplyr_rowwise", "cuplyr_scan")
idle_label <- c(cuplyr_rowwise = "cuplyr's rowwise form", cuplyr_scan = "the one-column cuplyr scan", duckdb = "DuckDB's rowwise form")
idle_safe <- NA_real_; idle_first_slow <- NA_real_
idle_finding <- "The idle probe (`idle.csv`, the driver's idle step) is not part of this data set."
idle_tab <- NULL; idle_scan_slowed <- FALSE; idle_rows_n <- NA
if (have_idle) {
  il$ok <- as.logical(il$ok); il$quiet <- as.logical(il$quiet)
  ilq <- il[il$ok & il$quiet, ]
  n_il_bad <- sum(!(il$ok & il$quiet))
  im <- stats::aggregate(secs ~ name + idle, data = ilq, FUN = stats::median)
  il_lv <- sort(unique(im$idle))
  im$base <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(im)), function(i) im$secs[im$name == im$name[i] & im$idle == min(il_lv)], 0)
  im$x <- im$secs / im$base
  slowed_at <- vapply(il_lv, function(t) any(im$x[im$idle == t & im$name %in% idle_gpu] > idle_factor), NA)
  idle_first_slow <- if (any(slowed_at)) il_lv[which(slowed_at)[1L]] else NA_real_
  idle_safe <- if (is.na(idle_first_slow)) max(il_lv) else max(il_lv[il_lv < idle_first_slow])
  idle_scan_slowed <- any(im$x[im$name == "cuplyr_scan" & im$idle > idle_safe] > idle_factor)
  imget <- function(nm, t, col = "secs") { x <- im[[col]][im$name == nm & im$idle == t]; if (length(x)) x[[1L]] else NA_real_ }
  ig <- il[il$name %in% idle_gpu, ]
  il_mem <- vapply(il_lv, function(t) stats::median(ig$mem_mhz_before[ig$idle == t], na.rm = TRUE), 0)
  il_mem_after <- stats::median(ig$mem_mhz_after, na.rm = TRUE)
  il_reps <- max(il$rep); idle_rows_n <- il$rows[[1L]]
  top <- max(il_lv)
  # nvidia-smi's performance state lags the clocks: reads with no idle time that report the
  # state read after the longest idle while the memory clock is already above that idle's
  ps_mode <- function(x) { x <- x[!is.na(x)]; if (!length(x)) NA_character_ else names(sort(table(x), decreasing = TRUE))[1L] }
  ps_top <- ps_mode(ig$pstate_before[ig$idle == top])
  ig0 <- ig[ig$idle == min(il_lv), ]
  n_ps_lag <- sum(ig0$pstate_before %in% ps_top & ig0$mem_mhz_before > il_mem[il_lv == top], na.rm = TRUE)
  ps_text <- if (is.na(ps_top)) "" else if (n_ps_lag) paste0(
    " The performance state `nvidia-smi` reported is not used: it lags the clocks. With no idle time ", n_ps_lag, " of the ", nrow(ig0), " reads before a cuplyr call report ", ps_top,
    ", the state reported after ", top, " seconds of idle, while the memory clock reads ", fnum(stats::median(ig0$mem_mhz_before[ig0$pstate_before %in% ps_top], na.rm = TRUE)),
    " MHz. The memory clock is the measure here.") else " The table gives the memory clock; the performance state is in `idle.csv`."
  # the median of the quiet reps, the lowest and highest in brackets, and their number
  spread_of <- function(x) if (!length(x)) "n/a" else sprintf("%s (%s-%s) n=%d", fnum(stats::median(x)), fnum(min(x)), fnum(max(x)), length(x))
  idle_tab <- data.frame(`idle (s)` = il_lv, check.names = FALSE)
  for (il_nm in intersect(names(idle_label), unique(im$name))) {
    idle_tab[[paste(idle_label[[il_nm]], "(s)")]] <- vapply(il_lv, function(t) spread_of(ilq$secs[ilq$name == il_nm & ilq$idle == t]), "")
  }
  idle_tab$`memory clock before a cuplyr call (MHz)` <- vapply(il_lv, function(t) {
    x <- ig$mem_mhz_before[ig$idle == t & !is.na(ig$mem_mhz_before)]
    if (!length(x)) "n/a" else if (min(x) == max(x)) fnum(x[[1L]]) else sprintf("%s (%s-%s)", fnum(stats::median(x)), fnum(min(x)), fnum(max(x)))
  }, "")
  idle_finding <- paste0(
    if (is.na(idle_first_slow)) "In this data set cuplyr does not pay for a GPU left idle. " else "cuplyr pays for a GPU that has been left idle. ",
    "The idle step (`idle.csv`) ran three calls on the wide table at ", lab_n(idle_rows_n),
    " rows (warm cache): cuplyr's rowwise form, a one-column cuplyr scan (one column read with `read_parquet_gpu` and collected), and DuckDB's rowwise form as a CPU control. Each call ran after the machine had been left idle for ",
    join_and(il_lv), " seconds, ", il_reps, " times for each idle time. Right before its pause every call was preceded by an untimed call of the same function, so the GPU had been idle for the pause whatever ran before (the time from the end of that call to the start of the timed one is the pause plus ",
    fx(min(il$gap_s - il$idle, na.rm = TRUE), 2), " to ", fx(max(il$gap_s - il$idle, na.rm = TRUE), 2), " seconds for the quiet-machine wait and the state query). `nvidia-smi` read the GPU's performance state and memory clock just before and just after every timed call (",
    n_of(n_il_bad, "call"), " of ", nrow(il), " ", if (n_il_bad == 1L) "was" else "were", " not quiet or failed and ", if (n_il_bad == 1L) "is" else "are", " left out). ",
    "With no idle time cuplyr's rowwise form takes ", fs(imget("cuplyr_rowwise", min(il_lv))), " and the scan ", fs(imget("cuplyr_scan", min(il_lv))), " (median); after ", top, " seconds of idle they take ",
    fs(imget("cuplyr_rowwise", top)), " and ", fs(imget("cuplyr_scan", top)), ", ", fx(imget("cuplyr_rowwise", top, "x"), 1), " and ", fx(imget("cuplyr_scan", top, "x"), 1),
    " times as long. DuckDB's form takes ", fs(imget("duckdb", min(il_lv))), " and ", fs(imget("duckdb", top)), " (", fx(imget("duckdb", top, "x"), 2), " times), so the CPU engine does not pay it. ",
    if (is.na(idle_first_slow)) paste0("No cuplyr median was more than ", fx(idle_factor, 2), " times its no-idle median at any idle time. ")
    else paste0("After ", idle_safe, " seconds of idle or less no cuplyr median is more than ", fx(idle_factor, 2), " times its no-idle median; after ", idle_first_slow, " seconds at least one is. "),
    "Before the calls after ", top, " seconds of idle, `nvidia-smi` reported a memory clock of ", fnum(il_mem[il_lv == top]),
    " MHz (median), against ", fnum(il_mem[il_lv == min(il_lv)]), " MHz with no idle time; just after a cuplyr call the memory clock was ", fnum(il_mem_after),
    " MHz (median over all of them). ",
    if (isTRUE(il_mem[il_lv == top] < il_mem[il_lv == min(il_lv)])) "So the slow calls are the ones that start on a GPU whose memory clock has come down; what decides when the clocks drop and how fast they come back (the driver's power management) is not examined here."
    else "The clocks read before the calls do not differ that way, so these data do not show what slows the calls down.",
    ps_text,
    " In the table each time is the median of the quiet reps, with the lowest and highest in brackets and their number (n).",
    if (!is.null(ilsup) && nrow(ilsup) && !"primed" %in% names(ilsup)) paste0(
      " An earlier run of the probe, without the untimed call before each pause (so a cuplyr call could follow DuckDB's pause as well as its own), is kept in `idle-superseded.csv` (", nrow(ilsup), " rows) and not used.") else "")
}
# the main cells: cuplyr's quiet reps that came more than idle_safe seconds after its previous call in the cell
gap_of <- function(d) {
  d <- d[order(d$started), ]
  t <- as.numeric(tstamp(d$started))
  d$gap <- c(NA, t[-1L] - (t[-length(t)] + ifelse(is.na(d$secs[-nrow(d)]), 0, d$secs[-nrow(d)])))
  d
}
gap_text <- "The idle probe is not part of this data set, so the gaps before cuplyr's calls are not judged."
gap_n_long <- 0L
if (have_idle) {
  cg <- do.call(rbind, lapply(split(tm[tm$engine == "cuplyr", ], paste(tm$variant, tm$table, tm$rows, tm$cache)[tm$engine == "cuplyr"]), gap_of))
  cgq <- cg[cg$rep >= 1L & cg$ok & cg$quiet, ]
  cgq$long <- !is.na(cgq$gap) & cgq$gap > idle_safe
  gap_n_long <- sum(cgq$long)
  gc_cells <- do.call(rbind, lapply(split(cgq, paste(cgq$variant, cgq$table, cgq$rows, cgq$cache)), function(d) {
    short <- d$secs[!d$long]
    data.frame(variant = d$variant[1L], table = d$table[1L], rows = d$rows[1L], cache = d$cache[1L], n_long = sum(d$long), n_short = length(short),
               med = stats::median(d$secs), med_short = if (length(short)) stats::median(short) else NA_real_, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }))
  gw <- merge(gc_cells, W[c("variant", "table", "rows", "cache", "best_med")], by = c("variant", "table", "rows", "cache"))
  gw$change <- gw$med_short / gw$med - 1
  gw$ratio <- gw$med / gw$best_med; gw$ratio_short <- gw$med_short / gw$best_med
  cls <- function(r) ifelse(r <= 1 / tie_tol, "win", ifelse(r >= tie_tol, "loss", ifelse(r < 1, "near win", "near loss")))
  gl <- gw[gw$n_long > 0L, ]
  flip_win <- sum((gl$ratio < 1) != (gl$ratio_short < 1), na.rm = TRUE)
  flip_cls <- sum(cls(gl$ratio) != cls(gl$ratio_short), na.rm = TRUE)
  gl_x <- gl[!is.na(gl$ratio_short) & cls(gl$ratio) != cls(gl$ratio_short), ]
  long_by_size <- tapply(cgq$long, cgq$rows, sum)
  long_sizes <- as.numeric(names(long_by_size)[long_by_size > 0])
  # how many short-gap reps the medians without the long ones rest on
  # (a cell with no short rep left is counted once, in the clause on cells that keep none)
  rest_tab <- table(gl$n_short[gl$n_short > 0L])
  reps_word <- function(k) if (k == 1) "a single rep" else paste(k, "reps")
  rest_text <- if (!nrow(gl)) "" else if (!length(rest_tab)) paste0(" Without them, none of those ", nrow(gl), " cells keeps a rep.") else paste0(
    " Without them, cuplyr's median rests on ", join_and(sprintf("%s in %d", vapply(as.integer(names(rest_tab)), reps_word, ""), as.integer(rest_tab))), " of those ", nrow(gl), " cells",
    if (any(gl$n_short == 0L)) paste0(", and ", sum(gl$n_short == 0L), " keep no rep at all") else "", ", so these medians are rough.")
  # the split is conservative: the probe's own gaps at idle_safe ran a little past idle_safe
  probe_gap <- max(il$gap_s[il$idle == idle_safe & il$name %in% idle_gpu & il$ok & il$quiet], na.rm = TRUE)
  long_gaps <- cgq$gap[cgq$long]
  n_long_in_probe <- sum(long_gaps <= probe_gap)
  n_long_untested <- if (is.na(idle_first_slow)) NA_integer_ else sum(long_gaps < idle_first_slow)
  split_text <- paste0(
    " The split is conservative: a rep counts as long once its gap passes ", idle_safe, " seconds, although the probe's own gaps at ", idle_safe,
    " seconds of idle ran to ", fx(probe_gap, 1), " seconds with no slowdown. Of the ", gap_n_long, " long reps, ", n_long_in_probe, " followed a gap no longer than that",
    if (!is.na(n_long_untested)) paste0(" and ", n_long_untested, " (those included) a gap shorter than ", idle_first_slow, " seconds, the shortest idle time at which the probe saw a slowdown (it tested none in between)") else "",
    ".")
  gap_text <- if (!gap_n_long) paste0(
    "In the main cells, every quiet cuplyr rep came at most ", fx(max(cgq$gap, na.rm = TRUE), 1), " seconds after cuplyr's previous call in its cell, within the ", idle_safe,
    " seconds of idle after which the idle probe saw no slowdown.") else paste0(
    "In the main cells, ", gap_n_long, " of cuplyr's ", nrow(cgq), " quiet reps came more than ", idle_safe, " seconds after cuplyr's previous call in the same cell, while the other engines ran (",
    idle_safe, " seconds is the longest idle after which the idle probe saw no slowdown): ",
    join_and(sprintf("%d of %d at %s rows", as.integer(long_by_size[long_by_size > 0]), as.integer(tapply(cgq$long, cgq$rows, length)[long_by_size > 0]), lab_n(long_sizes))),
    ", in ", nrow(gl), " cells, with gaps of up to ", fx(max(cgq$gap[cgq$long]), 1), " seconds. Leaving those reps out moves cuplyr's median in those cells by ", pct1(min(abs(gl$change), na.rm = TRUE)), " to ", pct1(max(abs(gl$change), na.rm = TRUE)),
    " (it is lower without them in ", sum(gl$change < 0, na.rm = TRUE), " of the ", nrow(gl), "), changes whether cuplyr has the lowest median in ", flip_win, " of them, and moves ", flip_cls,
    " across the ", fx(tie_tol, 1), " margin",
    if (nrow(gl_x)) paste0(" (", join_and(sprintf("%s on the %s table at %s rows, %s cache: ratio %s with them, %s without, from %s", gl_x$variant, gl_x$table, lab_n(gl_x$rows), gl_x$cache,
                                                 fx(gl_x$ratio, 3), fx(gl_x$ratio_short, 3), vapply(gl_x$n_short, reps_word, ""))), ")") else "",
    ".", rest_text, split_text, " The medians in the tables keep these reps.")
}

# ---- the rowwise pipeline ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# (rowwise.csv, rowwise-correctness.csv, rowwise-native.csv: the driver's rowwise_check and rowwise steps)
have_rw <- !is.null(rw) && !is.null(rwc) && !is.null(rwn)
rw_forms <- pp_rowwise_forms()
rw_label <- c(cuplyr_rowwise = "cuplyr rowwise", dplyr_rowwise = "dplyr rowwise", dplyr_vectorised = "dplyr vectorised",
              datatable_vectorised = "data.table vectorised", duckdb = "DuckDB")
rw_cols <- k_const$rowwise_cols
rw_cols_text <- paste0("`", rw_cols, "`")
RS <- data.frame(form = character(), rows = numeric(), cache = character(), status = character(), n = integer(), med = numeric())
rw_cap <- NA_real_; rw_sizes <- numeric(); cap_size <- c(); rw_cap_text <- ""
rw_correct_text <- rw_native_text <- rw_time_text <- rw_ratio_text <- rw_quiet_text <- rw_warm_text <- rw_groups_text <- ""
rw_best_text <- rw_reps_text <- rw_intro <- rw_method_text <- rw_cells_text <- rw_sup_text <- rw_gap_text <- ""
cap_at <- c()
rw_needed_text <- join_and(paste0("`", pp_columns("rowwise"), "`"))
rw_missing <- "The rowwise chunk is not part of this data set: `rowwise.csv`, `rowwise-correctness.csv` or `rowwise-native.csv` is missing, so the rowwise steps of the driver have not run."
rw_native_tab <- NULL; RR <- NULL
if (have_rw) {
  rw$quiet <- as.logical(rw$quiet); rw$ok <- as.logical(rw$ok)
  rw_sizes <- sort(unique(rw$rows))
  rw_cap <- max(rw$cap, na.rm = TRUE)
  rw_key <- function(d) paste(d$form, d$rows, d$cache, sep = "|")
  rwq <- rw[rw$rep >= 1L & rw$ok & rw$quiet, ]
  rw_cells <- unique(rw[c("form", "rows", "cache")])
  rw_cells$key <- rw_key(rw_cells)
  rw_sum <- lapply(split(rwq, rw_key(rwq)), function(d) {
    data.frame(key = rw_key(d)[1L], n = nrow(d), med = stats::median(d$secs),
               q25 = unname(stats::quantile(d$secs, 0.25)), q75 = unname(stats::quantile(d$secs, 0.75)),
               lo = min(d$secs), hi = max(d$secs), busy = stats::median(d$busy), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  })
  RS <- if (length(rw_sum)) merge(rw_cells, do.call(rbind, rw_sum), by = "key", all.x = TRUE) else cbind(rw_cells, n = NA_integer_, med = NA_real_, q25 = NA_real_, q75 = NA_real_, lo = NA_real_, hi = NA_real_, busy = NA_real_)
  RS$n[is.na(RS$n)] <- 0L
  rw_stat <- tapply(rw$status, rw_key(rw), function(x) { bad <- x[x != "ok"]; if (length(bad)) bad[[1L]] else "ok" })
  RS$status <- unname(rw_stat[RS$key])
  RS$status[RS$status == "ok" & RS$n == 0L] <- "noisy"
  RS$form <- factor(RS$form, rw_forms); RS <- RS[order(RS$cache != "warm", RS$rows, RS$form), ]; RS$form <- as.character(RS$form)
  capd <- RS[RS$status == "capped", ]
  cap_size <- if (nrow(capd)) tapply(capd$rows, capd$form, min) else c()
  # the elapsed time at the abort of each capped call (NA in data taken before it was recorded)
  rw_capped_rows <- rw[rw$status == "capped", ]
  cap_at <- if (nrow(rw_capped_rows)) tapply(rw_capped_rows$secs, rw_key(rw_capped_rows), max) else c()
  rw_cap_text <- paste0(fnum(rw_cap), " seconds")
  # groups in the result
  rw_groups <- max(rwc$result_rows, na.rm = TRUE)
  rw_groups_text <- paste0(rw_groups, " groups")

  # correctness
  rwc_n <- nrow(rwc); rwc_ok <- sum(rwc$status == "ok")
  rwc_other <- rwc[!rwc$status %in% c("ok", "capped", "not_run"), ]
  rw_correct_text <- paste0(
    rwc_ok, " of the ", rwc_n, " results (form and size) equal the base-R reference (keys exactly, measures within a relative tolerance of ", format(k_const$tol), ")",
    if (any(rwc$status == "capped")) paste0(". Aborted at the cap before they could be compared: ",
                                            join_and(sprintf("%s at %s rows", rw_label[rwc$form[rwc$status == "capped"]], lab_n(rwc$rows[rwc$status == "capped"]))), "") else "",
    if (any(rwc$status == "not_run")) paste0(". Not run, because the form had been capped at a smaller size: ",
                                             join_and(sprintf("%s at %s rows", rw_label[rwc$form[rwc$status == "not_run"]], lab_n(rwc$rows[rwc$status == "not_run"]))), "") else "",
    if (nrow(rwc_other)) paste0(". Wrong or failed: ", join_and(sprintf("%s at %s rows (%s)", rw_label[rwc_other$form], lab_n(rwc_other$rows), rwc_other$status))) else "",
    ". Every timed call's result was compared with the same reference, untimed.")

  # cuplyr's verdict, from F88's cuplyr_cpu_fallback condition
  rwn$native <- as.logical(rwn$native)
  rwn <- rwn[order(rwn$rows), ]
  rw_native_tab <- data.frame(rows = lab_n(rwn$rows),
                              verdict = ifelse(is.na(rwn$native), "error", ifelse(rwn$native, "native (no fallback condition)", "CPU fallback")),
                              `columns read` = ifelse(is.na(rwn$columns_read) | !nzchar(rwn$columns_read), "n/a", paste(lengths(strsplit(rwn$columns_read, ",")), "of", ncol_of("wide"))),
                              reason = ifelse(is.na(rwn$reason) | !nzchar(rwn$reason), "", rwn$reason), check.names = FALSE)
  # every timed cuplyr call watched for the same condition (rowwise.csv's `fallback`)
  cu_rows <- rw[rw$form == "cuplyr_rowwise" & rw$status != "not_run", ]
  have_fb <- "fallback" %in% names(rw)
  fb <- if (have_fb) as.logical(cu_rows$fallback) else rep(NA, nrow(cu_rows))
  n_fb_watched <- sum(!is.na(fb)); n_fb_hit <- sum(fb %in% TRUE)
  rw_fb_text <- if (!have_fb) "The timed calls of this data set were not watched for a fallback, so the verdict rests on the check step's run." else paste0(
    "The timed calls were watched too: a calling handler on `cuplyr_cpu_fallback` around each of the ", nrow(cu_rows), " timed cuplyr calls (every rep, the first call of each cell included) recorded ",
    if (n_fb_hit == 0L) "no fallback" else n_of(n_fb_hit, "fallback"), " (the `fallback` column of `rowwise.csv`)",
    if (n_fb_watched < nrow(cu_rows)) paste0("; ", nrow(cu_rows) - n_fb_watched, " of the calls have no record") else "", ".")
  rw_gpu_only <- all(rwn$native %in% TRUE) && have_fb && n_fb_hit == 0L && n_fb_watched == nrow(cu_rows)
  rw_native_text <- paste0(
    if (all(rwn$native %in% TRUE)) paste0("cuplyr's rowwise form ran natively at every size (", join_and(lab_n(rwn$rows)), " rows): the check step's run saw no `cuplyr_cpu_fallback` condition. ")
    else paste0("cuplyr's rowwise form ", join_and(sprintf("%s at %s rows", ifelse(is.na(rwn$native), "failed with an error", ifelse(rwn$native, "ran natively", "fell back to the CPU")), lab_n(rwn$rows))),
                ". Where it fell back, its timing is a CPU timing (the reasons are in the table). "),
    rw_fb_text,
    if (rw_gpu_only) " So every timed cuplyr call ran without a fallback, and the timings of that form are GPU timings." else "")

  # warm-up
  rw_warm_text <- if (is.null(rww)) "" else paste0(
    "Right before each cell, its forms were called ", n_of(max(rww$call), "time"), " each, untimed, on the ", lab_n(max(rww$warm_rows)),
    "-row file (", nrow(rww), " calls in all, `rowwise-warmup.csv`), so each form's start-up costs fall before its timed calls; the first call of a cell (rep 0) is recorded and kept out of the medians. ",
    "A warm-up does not keep the GPU from idling later in a cell; the separate cells and the gaps below are about that.")

  # timed calls and the load rule
  rw_timed <- rw[rw$rep >= 1L & rw$ok, ]
  rw_quiet_text <- paste0(
    "Of the ", nrow(rw_timed), " timed rowwise calls, ", sum(!rw_timed$quiet), " ", was_were(sum(!rw_timed$quiet)), " not quiet; the highest foreign share in a quiet call is ", pct1(max(rw_timed$busy[rw_timed$quiet])),
    " (limit ", pct(max(rw$busy_max)), "), and the highest wait before a call was ", fx(max(rw$wait_secs, na.rm = TRUE), 2), " seconds. The number of quiet reps behind every median is in the tables (n). ",
    "Residency before the calls: lowest ", pct(min(rw$resident[rw$cache == "warm" & rw$ok])), " (warm), highest ", pct(max(rw$resident[rw$cache == "cold" & rw$ok])), " (cold).")

  # ratios of cuplyr rowwise to every other form
  rw_get <- function(f, n, cache) RS[RS$form == f & RS$rows == n & RS$cache == cache, ]
  RR <- do.call(rbind, lapply(setdiff(rw_forms, "cuplyr_rowwise"), function(o) do.call(rbind, lapply(rw_sizes, function(n) do.call(rbind, lapply(c("warm", "cold"), function(cache) {
    cu <- rw_get("cuplyr_rowwise", n, cache); ot <- rw_get(o, n, cache)
    if (!nrow(cu) || !nrow(ot)) return(NULL)
    cu_ok <- cu$status == "ok" && cu$n > 0L
    data.frame(other = o, rows = n, cache = cache, other_status = ot$status, cu_med = if (cu_ok) cu$med else NA_real_,
               ratio = if (cu_ok && ot$status == "ok" && ot$n > 0L) cu$med / ot$med else NA_real_,
               bound = if (cu_ok && ot$status == "capped") cu$med / rw_cap else NA_real_, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }))))))
  span_of <- function(x) if (fnum(min(x)) == fnum(max(x))) fnum(min(x)) else paste("between", fnum(min(x)), "and", fnum(max(x)))
  cap1 <- function(x) paste0(toupper(substr(x, 1L, 1L)), substring(x, 2L))
  # dplyr rowwise has cells of its own, so a comparison is per size and cache state, not per cell
  sc_of <- function(n, more = FALSE) paste0(n, if (more) " more", if (n == 1) " combination" else " combinations", " of size and cache state")
  rw_vs_text <- function(o) {
    r <- RR[RR$other == o, ]; ok <- r[!is.na(r$ratio), ]; bd <- r[is.na(r$ratio) & !is.na(r$bound), ]
    lab <- rw_label[[o]]
    parts <- character()
    if (nrow(ok)) parts <- c(parts, sprintf("against %s, cuplyr's median is %s times its median in the %s where both have quiet reps (cuplyr is faster in %d of them and slower in %d)",
                                            lab, span_of(ok$ratio), sc_of(nrow(ok)), sum(ok$ratio < 1), sum(ok$ratio > 1)))
    if (nrow(bd)) parts <- c(parts, sprintf("in %s %s was capped, so there the ratio is below cuplyr's median divided by the cap, which is %s (a bound, not a measurement)",
                                            sc_of(nrow(bd), more = nrow(ok) > 0L), lab, span_of(bd$bound)))
    if (!length(parts)) paste0("There is no cell in which cuplyr rowwise and ", lab, " both have a quiet median or a cap.")
    else paste0(cap1(paste(parts, collapse = "; ")), ".")
  }
  rw_ratio_text <- paste(vapply(c("dplyr_rowwise", "dplyr_vectorised", "datatable_vectorised", "duckdb"), function(o) rw_vs_text(o), ""), collapse = " ")

  # the lowest median of each cell, by form
  ok_cells <- RS[RS$status == "ok" & RS$n > 0L, ]
  best_by <- vapply(split(ok_cells, paste(ok_cells$rows, ok_cells$cache)), function(d) d$form[which.min(d$med)], "")
  best_tab <- table(factor(best_by, rw_forms))
  # how many forms each combination compares (a capped or not-run form has no median)
  nf_tab <- table(vapply(split(ok_cells, paste(ok_cells$rows, ok_cells$cache)), nrow, 1L))
  nf_tab <- nf_tab[order(-as.integer(names(nf_tab)))]
  nf_text <- if (length(nf_tab) == 1L) paste0(names(nf_tab), " forms in each") else join_and(sprintf("%s forms in %d", names(nf_tab), as.integer(nf_tab)))
  rw_best_text <- paste0("Of the ", length(best_by), " combinations of size and cache state, comparing the forms with a quiet median in each, from both cells where there are two (",
                         nf_text, "), the lowest median belongs to ",
                         join_and(sprintf("%s in %d", rw_label[names(best_tab)[best_tab > 0]], as.integer(best_tab[best_tab > 0]))), ".")
  rw_reps_text <- join_and(sprintf("%s rows: %d", lab_n(rw_sizes), vapply(rw_sizes, function(n) max(rw$rep[rw$rows == n]), 1L)))
  rw_intro <- paste0(
    "The rowwise pipeline is a per-row computation. It reads the wide table, computes for every row the largest (`m`) and the sum (`s`) of the four double columns ",
    join_and(rw_cols_text), " (the filler columns have no missing values), and summarises by `category`: the count, the mean of `m` and the sum of `s`, ", rw_groups_text,
    ". It ran at ", join_and(lab_n(rw_sizes)), " rows. dplyr's rowwise route evaluates the expression once per row and gets slow fast, so every call had a cap of ", rw_cap_text,
    ", and a call over the cap was aborted and recorded as capped.")

  # the timing tables' prose (rw_method_text is built after rw_time_text, below)
  capped_cells <- RS[RS$status == "capped", ]
  abort_of <- function(key) { x <- if (length(cap_at) && key %in% names(cap_at)) cap_at[[key]] else NA_real_; if (is.na(x)) "" else paste0(", aborted after ", fs(x)) }
  rw_time_text <- paste0(
    if (nrow(capped_cells)) paste0("A call was aborted at the cap of ", rw_cap_text, " in ", n_of(nrow(capped_cells), "cell"), ": ",
                                   join_and(sprintf("%s at %s rows (%s cache%s)", rw_label[capped_cells$form], lab_n(capped_cells$rows), capped_cells$cache,
                                                    vapply(capped_cells$key, abort_of, ""))),
                                   ". These cells are shown as capped, not as a number (a capped call is never part of a median); a form capped at one size was not run at larger sizes, and those cells say so.")
    else paste0("No call reached the cap of ", rw_cap_text, "."))
  rw_method_text <- paste0("The quiet reps per cell are ", rw_reps_text, ". ", rw_warm_text, " ", rw_quiet_text, " ", rw_time_text)

  # how the forms shared cells: dplyr rowwise in cells of its own, the others together
  has_cf <- "cell_forms" %in% names(rw)
  rw_sh <- rw[rw$form != "dplyr_rowwise" & rw$status != "not_run", ]
  rw_own <- rw[rw$form == "dplyr_rowwise" & rw$status != "not_run", ]
  cell_chk <- do.call(rbind, lapply(split(rw_sh, paste(rw_sh$rows, rw_sh$cache)), function(d) {
    t <- as.numeric(tstamp(d$started)); t_end <- t + ifelse(is.na(d$secs), 0, d$secs)
    first_t <- tapply(t, d$form, min); last_t <- tapply(t, d$form, max)
    o <- rw_own[rw_own$rows == d$rows[1L] & rw_own$cache == d$cache[1L], ]
    to <- as.numeric(tstamp(o$started))
```
